('Q19','1) Break order: discard to hand limit; clear tokens on Action cards; recall workers/restock tiles; discard display folders 1–2, compact/refill; income; reset Break token. 2) Kiosk income is 1 per adjacent unique building, special enclosure, occupied standard enclosure, and pavilion; empty standard gives none, empty special counts. 3) For players receiving display cards during income, order clockwise from initiator (or first affected), refill after each such player before next affected player chooses.','Break procedure'),
('Q20','1) Conservation 2: upgrade action or activate worker. At 5 and 8: choose 5 money or available bonus tile. ('Q21','1) Shuffle 9 tiles; place random face-up tiles on the four blank yellow spaces beside 5 and 8 conservation (two each); do not use two icon spaces; return five unused to box. 2) If a component supply runs out, use suitable substitute; physical stock alone does not prohibit legal play.','Setup 2; Component supply'),
('Q22','1) Advanced maps: take two random and choose one, or lay out player count +1 and select in reverse turn order. 2) Map A begins with empty 3-space enclosure and kiosk on indicated spaces; printed kiosk counts as built and place tile reminder.','Personal setup A'),

('Q31','1) Count distinct adjacent water/rock hexes; multiple edges on one hex count once, and a larger region counts only actually adjacent hexes. 2) Decorative terrain illustrations on tiles do not count as terrain spaces/requirements.','Terrain adjacency; Counting icons'),
('Q32','1) Playing a new Release into Wild project gives its player 1 reputation; supporting an existing one does not. 2) Breeding Program family uses same condition on all three levels; choose any available reward space once condition met.','Release into the wild; ALL Breeding Program project cards'),

('Q34','1) Connected = uncovered and edge-adjacent to covered space; isolated = no adjacent covered space. 2) Border space has at least one of six sides without neighboring map hex. 3) Your zoo includes your played cards, map, personal supply; any zoo means these for all players.','Base glossary definitions'),
('Q35','1) Unique buildings must be placed when Sponsor played, using matching tile colored face up, freely rotated but not flipped. 2) Ordinary placement/terrain rules apply, no size-based payment; unique buildings are not enclosures and cannot house animals or count as terrain. 3) If placement impossible, cannot play Sponsor.','Unique buildings'),
('Q36','1) Both granted actions happen after Animals action finishes and its card moves to slot 1. 2) Use granted action’s card normally and move it after that action. ('Q37','1) Assertion searches unused face-down base-project deck and adds chosen project to hand; Dominance obtains named project from same deck, but has no effect if already in play. 2) Later play/support via Association, placing it above board, not in setup base row below.','Assertion / Dominance'),
('Q38','1) Resolve after Animals and moving Animals card. Clever chooses a card and moves it to slot 1; cards formerly left shift right. Boost moves named card to slot 1 or 5; moving to 5 shifts cards formerly right left.','Boost / Clever'),
('Q39','1) All four interactive abilities require affected zoo at least 5 appeal; multiplayer can replace interactive text with solo alternative on those cards. 2) Eligibility uses appeal before/after animal according to chosen order; new animal appeal may be resolved before or after ability.','Interactive abilities'),

('Q41','1) At effective strength ≤0, use enough X-tokens to reach at least 1, choose X-token alternative, or leave card until it reaches slot 3 or higher.','Constriction — affected players and card ownership'),

('Q50','1) Two Multiplier tokens add two executions: up to three total, not four. 2) X-tokens may be spent on multiplied regular executions; may multiply X-token alternative but cannot mix one X-token action with a regular action.','Multiplier: Additional Multipliers; Choices'),

('Q54','1) Target chooses five money or random hand-card draw; never Final Scoring. 2) If no hand cards, give money; with less than five money, give card; with neither, give all money including zero. 3) Resolve repeat pilferings sequentially; target may choose differently each time.','Pilfering X'),
('Q55','1) Pouch cards tucked under animal lose all function; if animal released discard tucked cards too, but retain appeal earned. 2) Sunbathing sold cards go to discard pile.','Pouch X; Scavenging / Sunbathing'),

('Q77','1) Each Build action may add one extra copy of a building built in that action without extra strength; pay normal cost and obey placement. 2) Only one extra building, and special-enclosure one-per-type limit still applies. 3) Final: 5 appeal with full map excluding water/rock.','217 Engineer'),
('Q78','1) Immediate: 2 money per water/rock icon. 2) May cover terrain spaces and ignore animal/unique-building terrain requirements; printed terrain icons still count. 3) Covered terrain no longer counts for Hydrologist, Geologist, Architectural Zoo. 4) Final: 2 appeal per water/rock icon pair, max 3 pairs.','219 Diversity Researcher'),

('Q82','1) Immediate: 1 X-token. 2) Each Release support grants 1 extra conservation; may support same release project repeatedly with different qualifying animals, max one token on project per Association action. Each token counts as separate support for other effects.','224 Migration Recording'),
('Q83','1) Immediate: 1 X-token. 2) Immune to Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis, Pilfering; for Hypnosis/Pilfering skip its counters and find next qualifying player. 3) Final: 1 conservation with all five continents.','225 Quarantine Lab'),
('Q85','1) Choose small or large permanently and mark box with supply token; reveal deck until that type found, keep it, discard others. 2) Cannot play opposite type. 3) Chosen small gain +2 appeal; chosen large +4; size 3 remains legal, no bonus.','227 WAZA Special Assignment'),
('Q86','1) Immediate: 2 money per small animal. 2) Animals action containing only small animals permits one extra small animal from hand, normal cost/rules. 3) Then may take small animal from display regardless reputation even if declined extra play.','228 WAZA Small Animals Program'),

('Q95','1) Place unique Barred Owl Hut under normal rules. 2) Each bird icon played draws two deck cards, keeps one, discards the other.','249 Barred Owl Hut'),

('Q98','1) Each predator icon played triggers Hunter with draws equal to total predator icons. A double predator icon triggers two sequential Hunters, counting both new icons each time.','252 Spotted Hyena Compound'),
('Q99','1) Place building and three supply tokens on its card. 2) Per herbivore icon played, may spend token and pay money equal to hand Sponsor level to play Sponsor meeting conditions. 3) Its own icon can trigger on play; three total uses. Card source is hand.','253 Okapi Stable'),
('Q100','1) Gain 1 reputation and 1 conservation; place Zoo School covering at least two border spaces. 2) Take one in-range display card or draw one deck card; simultaneous benefits may be ordered by you.','254 Zoo School'),
('Q102','1) Unique building may be placed over two border spaces without touching existing building; other rules apply. 2) Later buildings may attach. 3) Break income is 2 money per adjacent building except empty standard enclosures; it may stand beside kiosk. ('Q104','1) Immediate: 1 appeal per connected uncovered building border space, never water/rock. 2) Final: 1 conservation per six contiguous empty building spaces, evaluate each group separately. 3) Upgrade-restricted spaces count; terrain excluded.','260 Native Farm Animals'),
('Q106','1) Immediate: 2 money per different continent/animal-category icon; research excluded. 2) Each newly introduced category/continent gives 1 appeal and 2 money; double of same new icon gets novelty reward once.','262 Explorer'),
('Q107','1) Immediate: may place free size-5 standard enclosure under normal placement. 2) When playing large animal, ignore one left-side condition, not terrain. 3) Stacks with Research Institute to ignore two conditions.','263 WAZA Large Animal Program'),
('Q112','1) Gain 1 conservation for each animal category with more icons than player to your right. 2) If they have none, one of yours suffices. 3) Maximum 4 conservation.','Biodiverse Zoo (009)'),
('Q113','1) Observation Tower bonus applies only to standard enclosures adjacent to tower hex, not another rock hex. 2) Special enclosures do not qualify. 3) Refilling an emptied standard enclosure earns two appeal again. 4) Tower is not a building for kiosk income.','Map 1, Observation Tower'),
('Q114','1) Standard enclosure touching Outdoor Area hex counts two spaces larger for all purposes after placement; adjacency to other water alone does not qualify. 2) Cannot ignore size on release/transfer. 3) No special enclosure effect; Outdoor Area is not building.','Map 2, Outdoor Areas'),
('Q115','1) Building on Harbor-adjacent building space activates it; first building may start beside Harbor but need not. 2) Discard ability usable once per own turn, before/during/after action, not breaks/other turns. 3) Harbor is not building.','Map 4, Commercial Harbor'),
('Q116','1) Restaurant break income is 1 money per adjacent covered hex, regardless type/occupancy; empty enclosures qualify and each hex counts separately. 2) Restaurant is not building and gives adjacent kiosks no income. 3) Special bonus grants one free Reptile House OR Large Bird Aviary, even before Build II; not both, normal other placement rules apply.','Map 5, Park Restaurant'),
('Q119','1) Cover H spaces with buildings under ordinary placement rules; reveal deck until Sponsor, keep it, discard others. 2) H is not placement bonus, so no Archaeologist trigger. 3) After all three H spaces covered, every Sponsor level is one lower. 4) Third/fourth partner still require Association II and restricted building spaces still require Build II.','Map 8, Hollywood Hills'),
('Q123','1) Pay money equal to Sponsor level and meet usual conditions. 2) This bonus plays only from hand, even Sponsors II. 3) Sponsors action card stays in its slot; it does not move.','Official base FAQ: bonus granting Sponsor'),
('Q124','1) Appeal cannot exceed 113 and conservation cannot exceed 41; gains beyond those track ends are lost.','Official base FAQ: Appeal cannot exceed'),
('Q125','1) Venom affects every other zoo with higher appeal and at least 5 appeal. 2) Hypnosis targets highest appeal at ≥5, ties chosen by actor; self has no effect; copy only slots 1–3. 3) Pilfering 1 targets highest appeal; Pilfering 2 independently targets highest appeal and most conservation; each target ≥5, ties actor chooses, self no effect; conservation target must have ≥1. 4) Constriction affects each other zoo at ≥5 appeal ahead on appeal and/or conservation: one token on its slot 5 if ahead on one track, two on slots 4 and 5 if ahead on both.','Interactive target reference; Pilfering X'),
